_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 10 가정법의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 7과 가정법 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 가정법 과거: If+주어+동사의 과거형 ~, 주어+조동사 과거형+동사원형
가정법 과거완료: If+주어+had p.p. ~, 주어+조동사 과거형+have p.p.
without[but for] = if it were not for / if it had not been for

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: If I ran into my favorite actor at the airport, I ________ for an autograph.

choices.text: ask
asked
will ask
would ask
had asked

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: If Mina ________ to Canada, we might have kept in touch.

choices.text: doesn’t move
didn’t move
hadn’t moved
won’t move
wasn’t moving

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: I wish I [[live]] near the mountains someday.
But for the guide, Jiho [[would get]] lost.
I wish my parents [[gave]] me a puppy for my birthday.
If Sora [[knew]] about cars well, she could fix it by herself.
If Mina [[hadn’t changed]] her email address, I could have contacted her.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: If Jiho [[weren’t]] sick last Friday, we could have gone to the concert together.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: If Mina won the contest, she [[would have received]] a scholarship.

questions.prompt: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: Because it was too windy yesterday, I didn’t go out for a walk.
→ If it ________ too windy yesterday, I would have gone out for a walk.

questions.prompt: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: I don’t have a brother. I can’t play catch with him.
→ If I ________ a brother, I could play catch with him.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 통하지 않는 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: I’m sorry I can’t join you now. → I wish I could join you now.
In fact, Jiho doesn’t like the movie. → Jiho acts as if he liked the movie.
I’m sorry I can’t stay at this fancy hotel. → I wish I could stay at this fancy hotel.
As I skipped lunch yesterday, I was tired. → If I hadn’t skipped lunch yesterday, I wouldn’t have been tired.
Since the coat wasn’t on sale, Mina didn’t buy it. → If the coat were on sale, Mina would buy it.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작하지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: 네가 길에서 지갑을 발견하면 무엇을 할 거니? → What would you do if you found a wallet on the street?
사람들이 공원에 쓰레기를 버리지 않으면 좋을 텐데. → I wish people didn’t throw trash in the park.
지호의 실수가 알려졌다면, 그는 무척 당황했을 텐데. → If Jiho’s mistake is known, he would have been embarrassed.
그 소포가 제때 도착하지 않는다면, 내용물이 상할 텐데. → If the parcel didn’t arrive on time, the contents would go bad.
우리 형이 노크한 후에 내 방에 들어왔다면 나는 화가 나지 않았을 텐데. → I might not have been upset if my brother had come into my room after knocking.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 가정법 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 지호는 마치 그가 답을 아는 것처럼 미소 지었다. (the answer, as if, know)
questions.answer: as if he knew the answer

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 가정법 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 내가 그 코드를 안다면, 그 금고를 열 수 있을 텐데. (the code, open, can, know)

questions.point_label: 과거 사실의 반대는 if it had not been for
questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것 중 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: [[네 도움이 없었다면,]] I couldn’t have finished the project on time.

choices.text: Without your help
But for your help
If it were not for your help
Had it not been for your help
If it had not been for your help

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Were Mina here, we would have a great time.
If Jiho were my roommate, we could be good friends.
Had I practiced harder, I would have won the match.
If you didn’t check your answers, you won’t get a perfect score.
If Sora had worn a raincoat, she would not have gotten wet.

questions.point_label: 주절이 would have p.p.면 if절은 had p.p.
questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The sun was very strong yesterday. I walked outside for hours, and my face got burned. If I wore a hat, it would not have gotten burned.

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: I have read about a very special lake. The name of the lake is “Baikal.” Its water is incredibly clear. I wish I can visit it.
